events.description: $8M seed led by Blue Ashva Capital, co-led by Finvolve; six autonomous swarm satellites for military surveillance.
events.headline: $8M seed led by Blue Ashva Capital
$8M Seed Round Led by Blue Ashva Capital
events.description: Kepler Aerospace raised $8M in seed funding led by Blue Ashva Capital, co-led by Finvolve India Accelerator and India Accelerator. First external funding since 2018 founding. Two iDEX prime contracts secured with ~$4M in grants.

events.headline: WhiteWolf Payload Announcement at Bengaluru Space Expo 2026
events.description: Kepler co-developed WhiteWolf payload with Kawa Space, set to launch with TakeMe2Space aboard MOI 1B. MOU signed at Bengaluru Space Expo (BSX) 2026.

events.headline: Bharat Space Collective Formation
events.description: Kepler Aerospace among four space giants forming Bharat Space Collective (with Dfy Graviti, Kawa Space, Azista).

events.headline: TechGALA Japan Selection
events.description: Kepler Aerospace selected among Top 5 Indian startups for TechGALA Japan in Nagoya. India Accelerator and 01Booster Inc. facilitated.

events.headline: IN-SPACe Chairman Visit at BSX 2026
events.description: Pawan Goenka, Chairman of IN-SPACe, visited Kepler Aerospace at Bengaluru Space Expo 2026.

funding_rounds.source_title: Kepler Aerospace raises $8 million in seed round (ET)

products.name: Swarming ISR Satellite Constellation
products.description: Autonomous swarming satellite architecture where satellites communicate, task each other, and act in orbit without waiting for ground station. Six satellites equipped with electro-optical, thermal, and electronic-warfare sensors.

products.name: Ground Station as a Service (GSaaS)
products.description: Global network of 70+ hardened ground stations across 6 continents, available as a service. All major frequency bands (S, X, UHF, VHF). Ultra low latency mission operations.

products.name: Mission Operations as a Service
products.description: Primary mission operator for several ISRO satellites; serves nearly all Indian space companies. Fleet-level scheduling, virtualized modems, machine-to-machine operations.

products.name: Avionics as a Service
products.description: Flight-proven satellite subsystems including onboard computers, power systems, RF payloads, communication and navigation modules. Validated through missions with ISRO and national defence agencies.

products.name: Onboard Computers & Satellite Positioning Sensors
products.description: Products include onboard computers, satellite positioning sensors, solar panels, magnetic torquers, power modules, S-Band TxRx systems, proof of life transmitters, MEMS IMU systems, reaction wheels.
